# notes: Total vehicle exports in millions; nev_share_pct is NEV (BEV+PHEV) share of those exports by UNIT COUNT.
# notes: nev_mn and ice_mn are derived columns (total * share / 100).

# notes: By export VALUE the NEV share is roughly 2x the unit share because NEVs export at higher FOB prices (~$25-30k vs ~$12-15k for ICE). So the unit-share ~22% in 2024 corresponds to ~40% by export value — both numbers are correct measurements of different things.
